mapper.insert: INSERT INTO link (canonical_url, original_url, domain, title, description, primary_category_id, created_by_member_id) VALUES (#{canonicalUrl}, #{originalUrl}, #{domain}, #{title}, #{description}, #{primaryCategoryId}, #{createdByMemberId}) ON CONFLICT (canonical_url) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = link.updated_at

INSERT INTO member_saved_link (link_id, member_folder_id, display_title, note, primary_category_id, created_by_member_id) VALUES (#{linkId}, #{memberFolderId}, #{displayTitle}, #{note}, #{primaryCategoryId}, #{createdByMemberId}) ON CONFLICT (member_folder_id, link_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE member_saved_link SET display_title = #{displayTitle}, note = #{note}, member_folder_id = #{memberFolderId}, primary_category_id = #{primaryCategoryId}, updated_at = now(), updated_by_member_id = #{createdByMemberId} WHERE member_saved_link_id = #{bookmarkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_tag (owner_member_id, tag_name) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{tagName}) ON CONFLICT (owner_member_id, tag_name) DO UPDATE SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() RETURNING member_tag_id

INSERT INTO member_saved_link_tag (member_saved_link_id, member_tag_id) VALUES
(#{bookmarkId}, #{tagId})
ON CONFLICT (member_saved_link_id, member_tag_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT mf.member_folder_id AS "memberFolderId", mf.folder_name AS "folderName", mf.description AS "description", mf.folder_type AS "folderType", COALESCE(stats.cnt, 0) AS "bookmarkCount", stats.last_created_at AS "lastCreatedAt", COALESCE(stats.titles, '{}') AS "sampleTitles", COALESCE(tag_stats.tags, '{}') AS "topTags" FROM member_folder mf LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(msl.created_at) AS last_created_at, ARRAY( SELECT msl2.display_title FROM member_saved_link msl2 WHERE msl2.member_folder_id = mf.member_folder_id AND msl2.created_by_member_id = #{memberId} AND msl2.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY msl2.created_at DESC LIMIT #{sampleLimit} ) AS titles FROM member_saved_link msl WHERE msl.member_folder_id = mf.member_folder_id AND msl.created_by_member_id = #{memberId} AND msl.deleted_at IS NULL ) stats ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ARRAY( SELECT tag_row.tag_name || '(' || tag_row.tag_count::text || ')' FROM ( SELECT mt.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS tag_count, MAX(msl.created_at) AS last_used_at FROM member_saved_link msl JOIN member_saved_link_tag mslt ON msl.member_saved_link_id = mslt.member_saved_link_id AND mslt.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN member_tag mt ON mslt.member_tag_id = mt.member_tag_id AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE msl.member_folder_id = mf.member_folder_id AND msl.created_by_member_id = #{memberId} AND mt.owner_member_id = #{memberId} AND msl.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY mt.tag_name ORDER BY tag_count DESC, last_used_at DESC NULLS LAST, mt.tag_name ASC LIMIT #{tagLimit} ) tag_row ) AS tags ) tag_stats ON TRUE WHERE mf.owner_member_id = #{memberId} AND mf.deleted_at IS NULL AND mf.parent_folder_id IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN mf.folder_type = 'UNORGANIZED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, stats.last_created_at DESC NULLS LAST, mf.folder_name ASC LIMIT 100
